speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease. The clinical picture of a sexually active 17-year-old female with severe lower abdominal pain, dysuria, and burning on intercourse, combined with leukocytosis and elevated ESR, is highly suggestive of PID. I will request a CT scan to rule out a tubo-ovarian abscess before initiating treatment.
